get.description: Personal (USR) merchant session with biz:store:admin on the selected store. Read-only.

post.summary: Verify a login credential and list selectable merchant identities
post.description: Anonymous. Verifies PHONE_OTP / EMAIL_OTP / PASSWORD without issuing a session and returns a single-use identity ticket. PASSWORD requires the LOGIN captcha proof when captcha enforcement is on.

200.description: Envelope. code=0 success; 10452 captcha required (PASSWORD only); 10400 validation; credential errors use the existing login codes; 60001 banned account; 10402 when the verified identity's account vanished.

post.summary: Enter one identity with a login ticket and receive a merchant session
post.description: Anonymous (ticket-authenticated). OWNER/NEW_OWNER issues a USR merchant session (NEW_OWNER creates the account if needed); STAFF-<no> issues an MCH session. When the ticket came from /mine, the originating session is revoked on success.

200.description: Envelope. code=0 success; 10404 identity unavailable with data.identities (ticket kept, list narrowed); 10474 invalid/expired/consumed ticket or origin session no longer valid; 10402 account vanished; 60001 banned.
Check the existing business envelope code; full contract/signature and immutable source references are in app-foundation-api-2026-11-10.

post.summary: Claim: move the selected store under another owned entity
post.description: Personal (USR) merchant session with biz:store:admin on the selected store. Freezes the store, then advances the pay reservation and local commit synchronously (up to 5 phases); a non-terminal state is resumed via /biz/merchant/store-claims/{claimNo}/resume or the background recovery.

200.description: Envelope. code=0 (inspect state/lastError); 10403 MCH session, missing permission or storeNo mismatch; 10409 store not under the current entity, version mismatch, any blocker, or requestNo reused with a different body; 10505 feature disabled (shop.merchant.store-claim.enabled) or pay/subscription bridge unavailable; 10404 store snapshot missing.

get.summary: One owned entity with its stores
get.description: Personal merchant account (USR) only; no selected-store header needed. Not the caller's owned entity -> 10403 (not 10404).

200.description: Envelope. code=0 success; 10403 MCH session or entity not owned; 10404 membership exists but entity row missing; 10505 pay profile summary unavailable.

MerchantProfileSubmission.description: Independent PM only. Server fixes purpose=FIAT. No material references, actor, tenant or merchant in the body. Optional sensitive values are masked before persistence.

BizError.description: Business rejection envelope from GlobalExceptionHandler: HTTP 200 (401 only for missing/expired login), code != 0, data null.

LoginIdentity.description: LoginIdentityService.Identity. OWNER is the personal account's owner identity (all owned entities); STAFF is one MCH staff account found by the verified phone.

merchantNo.description: OWNER: first owned entityNo ("" when the account owns none); STAFF: the staff account's entityNo.

merchantName.description: Entity name. OWNER: only when exactly one entity is owned, else null; STAFF: entity name or null if the entity row is missing.

entityCount.description: OWNER: number of owned entities; STAFF: always 1.

role.description: Localized role label (Accept-Language). STAFF joins multiple labels with "、"; empty when no store roles.

roleCodes.description: OWNER: ["OWNER"]; STAFF: distinct sorted store role codes (MANAGER/CLERK/PICKER/COURIER/CS...).

storeCount.description: OWNER: stores under all owned entities; STAFF: distinct stores the account is granted.

LoginIdentityChoice.description: LoginIdentityService.IdentityChoice. The ticket is single-use and bound to the listed identityNo values.

identities.description: OWNER first (if any), then STAFF identities. May be empty.

canCreateOwner.description: true when no OWNER identity exists; enter may then use identityNo=NEW_OWNER.

currentIdentityNo.description: null from POST /biz/auth/identities; identityNo of the current session from GET /biz/auth/identities/mine.

credential.description: OTP code or password; never logged.

agreed.description: Login agreement accepted; stored on the ticket and used if entering creates a new account.

marketCode.description: Registration market, only applied when entering creates a new account.

identityNo.description: An identityNo from the ticket's list, or NEW_OWNER when canCreateOwner=true.

merchantNo.description: Current entity/merchant number; "" when the account has no merchant yet.

status.description: With merchant: ACTIVE / PENDING_LICENSE / SUSPENDED. Without: NONE / APPLYING / REVIEWING / REJECTED.

subject.description: Subject type; PERSONAL when no apply.

account.description: Verified login identifier of a USR session (phone, else normalized email); null for MCH sessions.

CaptchaRequired.description: GlobalExceptionHandler#onCaptcha for CaptchaRequiredException; same shape as biz-auth-captcha.openapi.json.

LoginIdentityUnavailable.description: BizIdentityController#unavailable: chosen identity is not (or no longer) available. The ticket is NOT consumed; its allowed list has been narrowed to data.identities, so the client can re-pick with the same ticket.

subjectType.description: USR session -> USER; MCH session -> MCH_ACCOUNT.

review.description: Without a pay profile summary: APPROVED (not PENDING_LICENSE) or NONE / REVIEWING / REJECTED from the latest apply. When a pay profile summary exists it is replaced by platformReview.

taxNo.description: Business licence number (apply item while pending, qualification otherwise); "" when unknown.

owner.description: Latest apply contactName; "" when no apply.

platformReview.description: Pay entity-profile summary platformReview; null when no summary.

StoreVO.description: merchant.dto.StoreVO. Market context fields are null unless the assembling service filled them.

StoreRelinkInspection.description: StoreRelinkPrecheck.Inspection: a current diagnostic only; the claim rechecks.

blockers.description: Distinct codes. Local: INVENTORY_HISTORY_UNKNOWN, SOURCE_NOT_PLACEHOLDER, CLAIM_IN_PROGRESS, TARGET_NOT_OWNED, TARGET_NOT_ACTIVE, TARGET_MARKET_MISMATCH, TARGET_STORE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, HAS_TRADES, APPLY_PENDING, INDUSTRY_HISTORY_UNKNOWN, SUBSCRIPTION_UNKNOWN, PAID_PLAN, ORGANIZATION_HISTORY, STORE_CONFIGURATION_HISTORY. Pay: PAY_SERVICE_UNKNOWN, FINANCIAL_HISTORY_UNKNOWN, PAY_SERVICE_APPLIED, HAS_TRADES plus any blocker codes returned by the pay service. RELINK_CONCURRENCY_UNAVAILABLE when shop.merchant.store-claim.enabled=false.

revokedStaff.description: Staff grants that the move would revoke.

executionReady.description: Feature enabled and pay financial-history check complete.

requestNo.description: Idempotency key; same key + same body replays, different body -> 10409.

state.description: Terminal: COMPLETED / ABORTED. Others are in progress; call resume.

stores.description: Only when COMPLETED: the owner's store groups (as GET /biz/stores/mine) after the move; otherwise null.

placeholderRetired.description: Source placeholder entity retired (it had only this store).

lastError.description: null, or PAY_UNAVAILABLE / PAY_STATE_CONFLICT / PAY_RESULT_UNKNOWN (retryable via resume) or abort reason PAY_ABORTED / PAY_REJECTED / LOCAL_REJECTED.

CaptchaToken.name: X-Captcha-Token
CaptchaToken.description: One-use LOGIN captcha proof (biz-auth-captcha.openapi.json). Read only when grantType=PASSWORD, and enforced only when shop.auth.captcha.enabled=true; missing/invalid proof then returns CaptchaRequired (10452).

StoreNoHeader.name: X-Store-No
StoreNoHeader.description: Selected store; must equal the {storeNo} path value and the resolved selected store, else 10403.
